meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

copy.tagline: 自动化浏览器交互与网页测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码操控浏览器并验证网页行为
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and test web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically and verify web page behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 playwright-cli 命令控制真实浏览器：打开网页、点击、输入文字、填写表单、截图、管理标签页和 cookie 等，每次操作后返回页面快照；还能运行和调试 Playwright 测试。
howto.when: 当用户要求操作浏览器（打开网页、点击、填写表单等）、测试网页，或要求 UI 审查/设计反馈时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com，并把页面内容告诉我
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器并返回页面快照。

say.text: 在登录页面填写用户名和密码，然后点击登录
say.note: Claude 会用快照里的 ref 定位并操作表单。

say.text: 给这个页面截个图保存下来
say.note: Claude 会执行截图命令保存图片。

howto.what_en: Claude can control a real browser via the playwright-cli command: open pages, click, type, fill forms, take screenshots, manage tabs and storage, and get a snapshot of the page after each action; it can also run and debug Playwright tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to operate a browser (open pages, click, fill forms), test web pages, or request UI review / design feedback.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me what's on the page.
say_en.note: Claude will launch a browser and return a snapshot.

say_en.text: Fill in the username and password on the login page, then click Login.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the fields via snapshot refs and submit.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of this page and save it.
say_en.note: Claude will run the screenshot command and save the image.
